answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: a new identity locks 40 POA and must tend real work in the shared garden of jobs — varied clients, real outputs, irregular hours — until the kernel of its behavior record proves unique. Each dawn the network samples fingerprints; a copied or idle profile stays locked and loses its deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA plus 1,000 work histories, while an honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit and earns undiluted rewards.
